distance_definition: Number of agent/user turns after the clue and before fast-forward; includes the evaluated pre-gap action and user acknowledgement.
clue: I ought to mention we bought it as a display unit, discounted from the shop floor.
clue_ablation_text: We bought it in the ordinary way, nothing special.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hi, my washing machine has stopped draining properly.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I can look at that. Do you have the model number?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, it starts with W-D-nine.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Is it plumbed into a standard waste pipe?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, the usual arrangement.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Is there parking near the property?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, right outside.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Would weekday or weekend suit for a visit?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Weekdays are easier.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Is the number ending in one-seven-four still yours?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, that is mine.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Would you like the outcome confirmed in writing?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, in writing please.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Does it make any unusual noise?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: There is a low humming sound.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: How was the appliance purchased originally?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I ought to mention we bought it as a display unit, discounted from the shop floor.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Have you cleaned the filter recently?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, I cleared it yesterday.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Is the machine level on the floor?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, it sits flat.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: How long has it been doing this?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: About four days now.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Open the cover claim and send it for assessment.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, I will wait to hear the outcome.

pre_gap_actions.description: Open the cover claim and send it for assessment.
Send an engineer before any assessment happens.
Approve a whole replacement machine straight away.
Talk the user through fixing it themselves first.
Close the request and ask the user to call back.

post_gap_actions.description: Take the repair through the seller channel that matches the original purchase route.
Send the identical claim for assessment again now.
Talk the user through fixing it themselves.
Leave the claim alone and wait another interval.
Close the request because the assessment interval has passed.

response_styles.description: Briefly acknowledge the user's impact or urgency before proceeding.
Proceed directly and neutrally to the next operational step.

questions.question: How long has the fault lasted?

tag_definitions.EARLY_CLUE_LOSS: The selected action is attractive when the early clue is unavailable or unused.
tag_definitions.STATE_SYNC_FAILURE: The action treats the pre-gap world as if it still held after time advanced.
tag_definitions.TIME_INFERENCE_FAILURE: The action fails to use elapsed time when interpreting the observation.
tag_definitions.REPEATED_ACTION: The action repeats a step already attempted without a new justification.
tag_definitions.PREMATURE_CLOSE: The action closes an interaction whose state is unresolved.
tag_definitions.PREMATURE_ESCALATION: The action escalates before supported diagnostic or policy steps are exhausted.
tag_definitions.ACTION_SELECTION_FAILURE: The action is inconsistent with the current state but has no narrower failure label.
tag_definitions.PROSODY_GROUNDING_FAILURE: The response approach does not match the audible delivery.
tag_definitions.BELIEF_REPORT_INVALID: One or more required state-belief distributions or revalidation flags are missing or malformed.
tag_definitions.STATE_BELIEF_ERROR: At least one required checkpoint assigns its highest probability to the wrong hidden state.
